How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Tripura Institution For Transformation Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Tripura Institution For Transformation to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Tripura Institution For Transformation (TIFT) for various contractual positions based in Tripura under advertisement number 7(5)/GA(GG)/2026/.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available across different designations such as Senior Consultant, Consultants, Research Associates, Program Coordination Associates, and Communications roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 01 October 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their applications starting from this date through the official portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application form is 15 October 2026. Applicants must complete their submissions before this deadline to avoid any technical failures.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹30,000/- to ₹1,50,000/- per month depending upon the specific post, hierarchy, and responsibilities associated with the position.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Qualifications range from Bachelor's degrees, diplomas, to Master's degrees in relevant disciplines such as Public Policy, Political Science, Mass Communication, Economics, Law, and Management.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit varies by post, being either 40 years or 50 years depending on the specific profile you are applying for under this notification.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by visiting the official recruitment website at https://recruitment.tift.org.in/ and filling out the application form as per the given guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official notification for any of the categories applying for these contractual posts at Tripura Institution For Transformation.

faq.question: Q10. What should I do if I face technical issues while applying?
faq.answer: In case of any technical issues during the online application process, candidates should attach a screenshot of the issue and email it directly to [email protected].
